text:
hannah: Quick sync 1: added a tiny doc patch to clarify tier migration semantics for customers migrating from legacy per-endpoint quotas to global-tier quotas. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1305

hannah: Key change: make it explicit that burst credits are per-tenant not per-endpoint, and show the minimal SDK snippet for calculating remaining burst credits. Suggestion to include a pointer to the usage dashboard panel `panel-burst-remaining`.

mike: small billing FYI: burst credits are consumed only after quota exhaustion and are capped by monthly burst_limit. include example for when burst_limit=0.

ash: docs: nice. please keep snippet language-agnostic but give one concrete JS example. highlight that the API returns `burst_remaining` as integer tokens.

docbot: docs-ci: preview ok but linter flagged a heading level mismatch in quotas.md: line 78.

hannah: fixed heading and pushed. snippet below: 

hannah: ```js
// compute remaining burst credits for tenant
const status = await client.usage.getLatest({ tenant_id: 'team-x' });
console.log(`burst_remaining: ${status.burst_remaining}`);
```

vera: product: add a 1-line UX caveat: dashboard panels aggregate per-tenant burst across projects; use project filter if you want narrower scope.

mike: billing ready to sign off after adding the `burst_limit=0` example. I added a comment in the PR.

hannah: added example sentence and pushed. CI green. planning to merge this afternoon unless anyone objects.

ash: LGTM.
